reservation.earlyReturnNote: Early-returned keys can be borrowed for remaining hours until 16:00 the same day.
reservation.returnDeadline: Next weekday (Mon-Fri) at 16:00. Keys borrowed on Friday are due Monday at 16:00.

rulesOfConduct: Do not pass key or student ID to others.
Maintain silence in the ITC2 library.
No kettles, fans (except small table fans), or alcohol allowed.
Report any damage immediately to bib-service-th-deg.de.
Close windows and doors before leaving.
Keep tables clean, dispose of trash, especially on weekends.
Do not rearrange chairs and tables.

emergency.alarmProcedure: Leave building immediately. Re-enter only after signal stops.
